scope: All 28 current rocker, guided, single-switch parallel and dual-switch parallel macro/fixture variants were rerun in isolated FreeCAD processes. Native closed-solid validity, preview/native bounds and volumes, external component clearance, independent occurrence movement and STEP/FCStd roundtrips passed. No prior native case proof was reused. Parallel installation checks include flat PETG flange support and a blind-pocket negative control, separate TPU sheets, split shoulders, through-tie engagement, antirotation pockets, ground/cable approaches and 1/3/6 mm host panels. Dual installation checks include ARM 1 manual left and ARM 2 servo right, 0.6 mm engraved legends, SAC/manual-lever travel and rear fastener tool access. Actual plugs, delivered guard adjustment, electrical behavior, force, printed strength, TPU compression and material performance remain unverified. The printMeshExports, panelMountExport and dualMountExport sections retain historical export-file proofs at their recorded sourceCodeSha256 values; those printable and CAD artifacts were not regenerated by this native audit.
